claim: All gameplay commands emitted by all in-world GUI instances are accounted for across the 41 solo overlays with zero port-introduced unresolved targets.

pc_runtime_contract.source: official GPL neo/ui/GuiScript.cpp and neo/game/Entity.cpp idEntity::HandleGuiCommands

pc_runtime_contract.named_activate_and_setkeyval: resolve an entity through case-insensitive gameLocal.FindEntity

The 893 implicit activations have statically closed MAP targets, but GUI state and timing require native interaction.
Final solo and co-op fidelity requires matched original-Xbox gameplay and visual evidence.
